products.name: MacroEconomics
products.description: The Macroeconomic Indicators dataset delivers standardized, structured, and regularly updated macroeconomic data for Vietnam, including GDP, inflation (CPI), interest rates, exchange rates, trade balance, and other key national indicators. It supports economic analysis, market forecasting, financial modeling, and strategic decision-making across banking, investment, fintech, and public sector applications.

datasets.name: Gross Domestic Product
datasets.description: Country-level GDP data over time, covering both current and constant price measures.

datasets.name: Inflation
datasets.description: Country-level Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, including inflation rates and average price levels.

products.name: Income
products.description: The Vietnam Income Prediction Suite delivers multi-scale estimates of average monthly income across Vietnam's provinces, districts, and wards. Built to overcome gaps in official income statistics, it supports detailed economic segmentation and planning at national and local levels.

datasets.name: Income Prediction by District
datasets.description: Model-driven predictions of average monthly income at the district level across Vietnam.

datasets.name: Full Income Prediction
datasets.description: Comprehensive income estimations for provinces, districts, and wards throughout Vietnam.

datasets.name: Income Prediction by Ward
datasets.description: Predicted average monthly income for each ward in Vietnam, for fine-grained urban and rural analysis.

products.name: Company
products.description: The Company data product offers standardized and continuously updated records of legal entities registered in Vietnam, including core business details, registration changes, legal status, and ownership data.

datasets.name: Company Information
datasets.description: Publicly available business information like tax code, industry, address, and more.

datasets.name: VSIC
datasets.description: A clean, machine-readable reference of Vietnam's VSIC 2018 codes with full hierarchy.

datasets.name: VSIC ISIC NAICS NACE
datasets.description: A crosswalk linking VSIC 2018 to NAICS and NACE, including mapping type and confidence.

products.name: Stock
products.description: The Stock data product provides clean, daily trading data for all listed companies on Vietnam's exchanges, supporting market tracking, strategy development, and portfolio analysis.

datasets.name: Stock Events
datasets.description: Key events affecting listed companies: corporate actions, earnings releases, and more.

datasets.name: Holder Trading
datasets.description: Transactions made by insiders and large shareholders in Vietnam's stock market.

datasets.name: Historical Price
datasets.description: Daily trading data for all stocks listed on HOSE, HNX, and UPCoM (adjusted and unadjusted).

datasets.name: Historical Dividends
datasets.description: All cash and stock dividend events declared by companies on HOSE, HNX, and UPCoM.

datasets.name: Narrative Index
datasets.description: How news-derived topics affect stock price movements, updated monthly.

datasets.name: FGI Index
datasets.description: Calculated Fear and Greed Index (FGI) for the Vietnamese stock market, based on the VN30 index.

datasets.name: Volatility Index
datasets.description: Market volatility index for the Vietnamese stock market.

products.name: Company Fundamentals
products.description: Vietnam Fundamentals delivers clean, comparable, and fully reconciled firm-level accounting data for every company listed on HOSE, HNX, and UPCoM, covering all sectors from 2000 onward.

datasets.name: Fundamental Annual
datasets.description: Year-end income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements for HOSE, HNX, and UPCoM.

datasets.name: Fundamental Quarterly
datasets.description: Quarterly income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements for HOSE, HNX, and UPCoM.

products.name: Mutual Fund
products.description: Comprehensive information about mutual funds in Vietnam, including fund identification, classification, NAV performance, and detailed asset allocation.

datasets.name: Fund Information
datasets.description: Fund identification and classification.

datasets.name: NAV Report
datasets.description: Net asset value (NAV) performance over time.

datasets.name: Top Holding List
datasets.description: Largest holdings per fund.

datasets.name: Industry Holding List
datasets.description: Fund holdings broken down by industry.

datasets.name: Asset Holding List
datasets.description: Detailed asset allocation per fund.

products.name: News
products.description: The News data product delivers curated, tagged, and structured news content from reputable Vietnamese sources, enabling users to track business, economic, and regulatory events.

datasets.name: News
datasets.description: Curated, tagged, structured news content from reputable Vietnamese sources.

products.name: Bank
products.description: The Bank data product provides verified, up-to-date information on all licensed banks operating in Vietnam, including legal identity, branch networks, shareholder structure, and regulatory status.

datasets.name: Bank Fundamentals Quarterly
datasets.description: Quarterly fundamentals for licensed Vietnamese banks.

datasets.name: Bank Fundamentals Annual
datasets.description: Annual fundamentals for licensed Vietnamese banks.
